### Spire declares dividend

[](https://markets.ft.com/data/announce/full?dockey=600-202604301430PR_NEWS_USPRX____CG46879-1)
Apr 30 2026 19:30 BST
ST. LOUIS , April 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Spire Inc. (NYSE: SR) board of directors declared a quarterly common stock dividend of $0.825 per share, payable July 2, 2026, to shareholders of record on June 11, 2026.
[ ![Spire logo \(PRNewsfoto/Spire Inc.\)](https://mma.prnewswire.com/media/1818129/Spire_Logo.jpg) ](https://mma.prnewswire.com/media/1818129/Spire_Logo.html)
Spire has continuously paid a cash dividend since 1946, with 2026 marking the company's 23rd consecutive year of increasing its common stock dividend on an annualized basis.
**About Spire**
At Spire Inc. (NYSE: SR) we believe energy exists to help make people's lives better. It's a simple idea, but one that's at the heart of our company. Every day we have the honor of serving close to 2 million homes and businesses, making us one of the largest publicly traded natural gas companies in the country. We help families and business owners fuel their daily lives through our gas utilities serving Alabama, Mississippi, Missouri and Tennessee. Our natural gas-related businesses include Spire Marketing and Spire Midstream. We are committed to transforming our business through growing organically, investing in infrastructure, and driving continuous improvement. Learn more at [SpireEnergy.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4676549-1&h=4081052415&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4670055-1%26h%3D4010335002%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.spireenergy.com%252F%26a%3DSpireEnergy.com&a=SpireEnergy.com).
